modules.verity_vllm.commitments.vllm_v1.vectors: the generator of the vllm-v1 conformance vectors (vectors.json), run as a module by hand and held to its file by tests/commitments/test_vllm_v1.py

modules.verity.definitions.numerics.ref_prims_tw: numpy twins of registry.ref_prims, checked against the registered bodies by tests/program/test_ref_prims.py (LIVE registry.ref_prims)
modules.verity_vllm.program.lifting.lifted_compo: the lifted fixed workload Program (GP-01's compose over lifted components) of tests/program/test_lifted_mixed.py / test_lifted_r17.py (LIVE registry.lifted)
modules.verity_vllm.program.frontend.derive_exam: source modules of the derivation tests (LIVE frontend.derive)
modules.verity_vllm.program.frontend.examples: authored examples of the torch-frontend tests (LIVE frontend.torch_frontend / correspond)
modules.verity_vllm.program.lifting.dump: complete-assignment dump used by tests/program/test_lifted_tiny.py (LIVE registry.lifted / pad_prims)
modules.verity.definitions.numerics.fa3_split_tw: numpy twins of registry.fa3_split's Definitions, checked word for word against them by tests/program/test_fa3_split.py (LIVE registry.fa3_split) and run by the H200 capture tests/properties/glm53_fa3_prefill_capture_gpu.py; live once a replay row binds AttentionSplit_v1
modules.verity.definitions.numerics.deepgemm_sch: DeepGEMM's cc 9.0 launch-configuration model (the chosen layout, its boundaries over M, the sweep and the JIT template arguments), pinned by tests/program/test_deepgemm_schedule.py and read by the capture tests/properties/deepgemm_capture_gpu.py; live once a Program carries a schedule claim
modules.verity.definitions.numerics.nvfp4_twins: the NVFP4 linear's device layouts (scale swizzle, packed E2M1 codes), whose offsets and packing tests/program/test_nvfp4.py checks (LIVE registry.nvfp4, its Definitions); live once a Commit opens an NVFP4 linear
modules.verity.definitions.numerics.program_walk: the training step's call-by-call walk against its GPU dump, checked by verity/definitions/tests/test_program_walk.py and run on the dump remotely; live once TrainStep_v1's check reads it
modules.verity.definitions.numerics.torch_blocks: numpy models of the training step's blocks (registry.torch_attention, torch_loss, torch_embedding, torch_clip), which verity/definitions/tests/test_torch_*.py hold each block to word for word and program_walk calls by family on the GPU dump; live once TrainStep_v1's check reads them
modules.verity.definitions.numerics.torch_step: numpy models of TrainStep_v1's own nodes (F.linear's GEMMs, the transpose, RMS norm, SiLU, the master grad, AdamW and the bf16 copy-back), which verity/definitions/tests/test_torch_step.py holds to bits and program_walk calls by family on the GPU dump; live once TrainStep_v1's check reads them
modules.verity_vllm.protocols.linear: the linear-site interface; no module of the package imports it, its callers are benchmarks/pouw/pearl_c_vllm/e2e.py and bench_arm.py; tests/linear
modules.verity_vllm.protocols.linear.vllm_site: see verity_vllm.protocols.linear; benchmarks/pouw/pearl_c_vllm/e2e.py and bench_arm.py attach through it

modules.verity_vllm.program.quarantine.act.silu_: properties-admission adapter of SiluMul_v2, loaded by --adapter name
modules.verity_vllm.program.quarantine.dense.sof: re-exports registry.dense's AttentionSoftcap_v1 (promoted) with its quarantine SEMANTIC_ID; tests/engine/test_gen_dense_softcap.py
modules.verity_vllm.pipeline.tp.wires: the TP window over all W ranks (pipeline.tp.wires.sites_circuit over program.tp_binding's bindings of program.predict.tp_steps' rank Programs, composed by program.tp_workload), read by tests/program/test_tp_binding.py, tests/program/predict/test_tp_steps.py and tests/pipeline/test_tp_wires.py; the TP served Commit (pipeline.tp.commit) commits each rank's rows and builds no window yet, and this entry goes once that Commit builds the TP window

modules.verity_vllm.program.tp_workload: the TP window over all W ranks (pipeline.tp.wires.sites_circuit over program.tp_binding's bindings of program.predict.tp_steps' rank Programs, composed by program.tp_workload), read by tests/program/test_tp_binding.py, tests/program/predict/test_tp_steps.py and tests/pipeline/test_tp_wires.py; the TP served Commit (pipeline.tp.commit) commits each rank's rows and builds no window yet, and this entry goes once that Commit builds the TP window
modules.verity.definitions.tiny: the tiny whole-model configurations (TINY, TINY_NOBIAS, TINY_FP8) at which the registry's circuit-check sidecars (verity/definitions/registry/*.circuit-check.py) and circuit_check.targets bind whole-model roots; neither is a vLLM entry point
modules.verity_vllm.program.predict.template_cou: n_t(c), each template's instances in a request unit's Program read off its key, held to the built Programs' template partitions by tests/program/predict/test_template_counts.py ahead of the compile that reads it (LIVE predict.step_needs)
modules.verity_vllm.pipeline.long_row: the check template of a two-stage window over one of DSA's long rows (DsaTopKReadRowsCut_v1, which layout registers over the window's class), read by its circuit-check sidecar and held to DsaTopKReadRows_v1 by tests/pipeline/test_long_row.py and tests/pipeline/test_serving_rows_bits.py; it stands in for the request Definition that will hold the row
